hypothesis: Capture the existing Torch CAM++ forward in an exact-shape CUDA graph to eliminate repeated host launches; keep weights, operators and precision unchanged.
evidence: Independent prompt component diagnostic: CAM++12.6ms of total25.3ms. This cannot alone close the throughput gap but may compose with pipeline improvements.
difference_from_prior_TRT_failure: No ONNX/TensorRT conversion or operator fusion. Replay exactly the current Torch graph, keyed by shape and CUDA precision flags.
scope: New default-off speaker graph option. Bounded graph cache, eager fallback for unsupported input/policy, owned outputs protect cached embeddings from later replays.
correctness_gate: Bitwise equality against the same eager Torch model on real reused reference features; graph output ownership, shape fallback and precision-policy separation tests. No service trial if numerical gate fails.
performance_gate: Measure warmed component latency first; service trial only after material component improvement.
quality_contract: All final speech noninferiority gates unchanged;256 holdout unused.
implementation_design: Reuse existing exact-shape EncoderCudaGraph manager with four-shape cap, owned outputs and stream isolation; consumer-local speaker wrapper leaves shared eager model untouched; changed precision policy or autocast uses eager fallback.
feasibility_gate: Four real reference inputs bitwise equal, zero max absolute error; warmed eager11-13ms versus graph4.9ms. Production wrapper and service gates still pending.
